### Changes

- Add HDR Bridge for Android with per-task output settings, a sequential task queue and in-app updates.
- Add Photo Frame on Windows and Android: a blurred border, camera logo and caption, exported as Ultra HDR JPEG.
- Improve output metadata compatibility by omitting source camera MakerNotes while preserving standard EXIF fields.

The Android APK requires ARM64 and Android 8.0 or later. Native HDR preview requires Android 14 or later, an HDR display and a gain-map image supported by the system decoder.

Windows builds are unsigned and may trigger a SmartScreen warning. See the measured [compatibility matrix](https://github.com/RockLithium/hdrbridge/blob/v1.4.0/docs/COMPATIBILITY_MATRIX.md) for application support.
